title: Optimizing your runs for lower compute, fresher data, and faster iteration with dbt State
description:
dbt State cut dbt Labs' own orchestration jobs from 19 to 2: model-level freshness, auto-deferral, and zero-copy cloning explained. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Reuben McCreanor, product manager at dbt Labs leading dbt State, and Iaroslav Zeigerman, principal software engineer at Fivetran and a lead developer of dbt State, explain the idea: every run should only build what actually changed, with freshness logic moved out of job schedules and into model-level rules. dbt Labs' own project went from 19 clashing jobs to 2. Fanatics saw 25-30% model reuse and roughly 15% in Snowflake savings on its pilot project.

In this session you'll learn:
• How model-level freshness replaces fixed job schedules
• How auto-deferral and zero-copy cloning reduce compute
• What early customer results look like

Speakers: Reuben McCreanor, dbt Labs; Iaroslav Zeigerman, Fivetran

Learn more about dbt State: https://www.getdbt.com/product/dbt-state
